brand_identity.name: Hikmah Tutors Rajshahi (হিকমাহ টিউটরস রাজশাহী)
brand_identity.tagline: রাজশাহীর বিশ্বস্ত ও নির্ভরযোগ্য টিউটর প্ল্যাটফর্ম
brand_identity.cultural_context: Bangla-first, mobile-first Rajshahi educational tutoring network
brand_identity.theme: Light theme (Cream base with Forest Green depth and Mango accents)

fonts.heading: Noto Sans Bengali, Hind Siliguri, sans-serif
fonts.body: Noto Sans Bengali, Hind Siliguri, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug

rules: Bengali text requires higher line-height (leading-bn: 1.7) to prevent script overlapping
Never use Inter or generic sans for Bengali primary headers
Ensure proper fallback stack: Noto Sans Bengali -> Hind Siliguri -> system-ui

textures.noise: subtle SVG grain overlay for hero depth

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. All text against cream background has > 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: All buttons and interactive chips MUST have a minimum height of 48px on mobile devices.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and status elements MUST contain unique data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

Header.description: Sticky top bar with brand logo, quick access to Tutor/Admin panels, and language switch.
improvements: Replace standard bg-cream/95 with solid backdrop-blur-md and a subtle 1px border-b border-brand-100/80 to prevent content bleed.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to logo, tutor panel, admin panel, and language toggle.
Ensure navigation pills have a minimum touch target height of 44px on mobile and 48px on desktop.

TuitionCard.description: Primary card component for displaying individual tuition opportunities.
improvements: Maintain high-visibility top GenderStrip with exact color coding: Male (Blue #1D4ED8), Female (Rose #E11D48), Any (Emerald #059669).
Highlight Salary with an expressive bold font size (text-2xl to text-3xl) in Forest Green.
Include quick action bar at card bottom: Apply (primary solid brand button), Save (heart toggle icon), Share (native/modal trigger).
Add structured data-testid on all key text fields: class, subjects, area, days, salary, code, time.

FilterBarAndSheet.description: Horizontal quick filter bar on desktop and bottom drawer sheet on mobile.
improvements: Floating elevated filter container overlapping hero section with -mt-7 offset.
Horizontal scrollable pill list for instant area, class, gender, and salary filtering.
Filter sheet includes clear reset all button and live result counter update.

GuardianRequestForm.description: Form for parents/guardians to submit new tuition requirements directly.
improvements: Grouping class/batch choices into clear visual categories: Primary (Play-5), Secondary (6-10, SSC), Higher Secondary (HSC 1st/2nd, HSC batch), Admission, O/A Level.
Provide explicit gender preference selection with matching color cues.
Cardless or soft-tinted section containers with 24px padding to avoid visual clutter.

EmptyAndErrorStates.description: Feedback containers for no results or network errors.
improvements: Friendly Bengali text descriptions with relevant Lucide icon (SearchX for empty, WifiOff for errors).
Include an actionable reset button with minimum 48px touch height.

AdminAndTutorPanels.description: Internal work queue, lead manager, tuition editor, application comparer, and tutor dashboard.
improvements: Keep panels accessible directly without hard auth wall while displaying clear demo/preview banner.
Density mode layout for admin tables with compact cell padding, clear badges, and WhatsApp deep-link actions.
Mobile bottom tab bar navigation for tutor workspace.

Phase_1_Public_Board_Polish: Refine TuitionCard gender strip contrast, salary typography, and 48px touch targets for action buttons.
Polish Header sticky behavior with backdrop blur and testid coverage.
Enhance Search Bar focus states, clear button positioning, and submit responsiveness.
Phase_2_Form_And_Filters_Polish: Upgrade ClassPicker with grouped chip layout for exact batches (SSC 2026-28, HSC Year/Batch).
Improve FilterSheet drawer animation and multi-select clarity.
Polish Guardian Request Form with structured section steps and success feedback toast.
Phase_3_Panels_And_Workspaces: Improve Admin Work Queue card layout with legacy class warning flags.
Polish Tutor Dashboard checklist, saved tuitions view, and application timeline.
Ensure dynamic code export ZIP button in footer works seamlessly and stays visually prominent.

image_urls.hero_background: subtle vector dot grid pattern with SVG transparency

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Retain Bangla-first interface and Bengali numerical formatting where applicable.
Do NOT add fake testimonials, false user review scores, or fake metrics.
Do NOT advertise guaranteed premium paid tuition or checkout flows (keep premium unpublished).
Maintain gender color coding strictly: Male (Blue), Female (Rose), Any (Green).
Ensure every interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Ensure total responsive fidelity across mobile (360px+), tablet, and desktop screens.
